`sglang/qwen4exp-serving-73a255206f.patch` is the serving patch, against SGLang at commit `7.py --url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --prompt-tokens 101 421 1701 6821 10001 --max-tokens 128
```

`scripts/serve.sh` is the launcher that produced the published numbers. It sets the environment, applies the
patch list, launches SGLang and waits for `/health`. The published configuration is `--max-running-requests 1`
with `--enable-ple`; `--enable-ple` is the only way to reach the full 262,144-token context (CAMPAIGN.md:448).
The PLE table is read from `PLE` (default `~/quant/model/ple`); `--ple-weights-dir` is the directory that
contains `ple.json` and `ple.f8_e4m3.bin`.

## Repository layout

```
sglang/         the serving patch (qwen4exp-serving-73a255206f.patch) and the layered patch scripts it was built from
patches/        the patch scripts, by layer: model, quantization, KV cache tiers, elastic expert cache, PLE
kernels/        the Triton kernels: int2 MoE gemm, int4 KV gemm, int8 ring KV gemm, int4 KV quantization
assets/         the two serving assets: the PLE table (ple.f8_e4m3.bin + ple.json) and the phase-1 state
tools/          the measurement tools: bench.py, ngram.py, ngram_quality.py, ngram_quality_tiers.py
docs/           CAMPAIGN.md (the engineering log), the design documents with their outcomes, the measurement logs
scripts/        serve.sh (the launcher), build.sh (the patch stack), setup.sh (the virtualenv),
              quantize.sh (the quantization recipe), ngram.sh (the n-gram table build),
              ngram_quality.sh (the quality test), ngram_quality_tiers.sh (the same test on the KV tiers)
```
